segments.thag18.1:1.1: “Na gaṇena purakkhato care, vimano hoti samādhi dullabho;
segments.thag18.1:1.3: Nānājanasaṅgaho dukho, iti disvāna gaṇaṃ na rocaye.
segments.thag18.1:2.1: “Na kulāni upabbaje muni, vimano hoti samādhi dullabho;
segments.thag18.1:2.3: So ussukko rasānugiddho, atthaṃ riñcati yo sukhāvaho.
segments.thag18.1:3.1: “Paṅkoti hi naṃ avedayuṃ, yāyaṃ vandanapūjanā kulesu;
segments.thag18.1:3.3: Sukhumaṃ salla durubbahaṃ, sakkāro kāpurisena dujjaho.
segments.thag18.1:4.3: Bhuñjantaṃ purisaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ, sakkaccaṃ taṃ upaṭṭhahiṃ.
segments.thag18.1:5.1: “So me [taṃ (sī. ka.)] pakkena hatthena, ālopaṃ upanāmayi;
segments.thag18.1:5.3: Ālopaṃ pakkhipantassa, aṅguli cettha [pettha (sī. ka.)] chijjatha.
segments.thag18.1:6.3: Bhuñjamāne vā bhutte vā, jegucchaṃ me na vijjati.
segments.thag18.1:7.5: Yassete abhisambhutvā [abhibhuñjati (?)], sa ve cātuddiso naro.
segments.thag18.1:12.3: Kuñjarābhirudā rammā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.
segments.thag18.1:14.3: Vāraṇābhirudā rammā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.
segments.thag18.1:15.3: Abbhunnaditā sikhīhi, te selā ramayanti maṃ.
segments.thag18.1:21.1: “Na pañcaṅgikena turiyena, rati me hoti tādisī;
segments.thag18.1:22.1: “Kammaṃ bahukaṃ na kāraye, parivajjeyya janaṃ na uyyame;
segments.thag18.1:22.3: Ussukko so rasānugiddho, atthaṃ riñcati yo sukhāvaho.
segments.thag18.1:23.3: Kicchati kāyo kilamati, dukkhito so samathaṃ na vindati.
segments.thag18.1:25.3: Na taṃ viññū pasaṃsanti, patthaddhamānasaṃ naraṃ.
segments.thag18.1:26.1: “Yo ca seyyohamasmīti, nāhaṃ seyyoti vā pana;
segments.thag18.1:26.3: Hīno taṃsadiso [tīnohaṃ sadiso (syā.)] vāti, vidhāsu na vikampati.
segments.thag18.1:28.3: Ārakā hoti saddhammā, nabhato puthavī yathā.
segments.thag18.1:34.3: Yassa te nābhijānāma, yampi nissāya jhāyati [jhāyasi (ka. aṭṭha.)].
segments.thag18.1:36.3: Sāriputtaṃ tadā disvā, kappinassa sitaṃ ahu.
segments.thag18.1:37.3: Dhutaguṇe visiṭṭhohaṃ, sadiso me na vijjati.
segments.thag18.1:38.3: Ohito garuko bhāro, natthi dāni punabbhavo.
segments.thag18.1:41.3: Ekova thero gāthāyo, cattāsīla duvepi cāti.
